name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a listed sequence (find key, pick it up, open door, enter room, pick up ball), and the candidate correctly gives the hard Existence(target_picked_up) on the last event plus hard Precedence between each consecutive pair (key_found→has_matching_key, has_matching_key→target_door_open, target_door_open→target_room_entered, target_room_entered→target_picked_up). The chain together with the last Existence forces every earlier event, so no Existence on the earlier steps is needed and none is redundant; priorities are all hard, matching the imperative wording with no preference cue.

texts: Find the matching key before picking it up.
Pick up the matching key before opening the locked door.
Open the locked door before entering the target room.
Enter the target room before picking up the target ball.
Eventually pick up the target ball.
